title: Understanding the Feature Encoding
text: The feature encoding aims to capture the cyclical nature of time throughout the day. Consider how the cosine function behaves over a 24-hour period.

title: Cosine Function Properties
text: Recall that the cosine function has a period of $$2\pi$$. How does this relate to the 24-hour cycle of a day?

hintAnswer: The division by $$12$$ scales the $$time_{of,day}$$ to fit within the period of the cosine function which is $$2\pi$$.
title: Adjusting the Cosine Function
text: To adjust the cosine function to fit a 24-hour cycle, we use the expression $$cos\left(\frac{\pi time_{of,day}}{12}\right)$$. Why is the division by $$12$$ necessary?

title: Interpreting the Expression
text: The expression $$1-cos\left(\frac{\pi time_{of,day}}{12}\right)$$ is used to create a feature that peaks at certain times of the day. What does the subtraction from $$1$$ achieve?

hintAnswer: The subtraction from $$1$$ inverts the cosine wave creating a peak at times when the cosine value is at its minimum.
title: Purpose of Subtraction
text: Subtracting from $$1$$ inverts the cosine wave, creating a feature that peaks at times when the cosine value is at its minimum. This aligns with the expected increase in calls around lunch time.
